perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; directed reroute: Turn the variational invariant into an actual determination: prove a two-sided quantitative bound for gamma(S) as an explicit function of the leverage profile diag(P_S) (e.g. a matching upper bound in terms of max_i (P_S)_ii or the leverage dispersion), so the admissibility threshold is read off the score matrix rather than from an exponential enumeration, and push the already-established block-sum moment-polytope reduction through to closed-form v* and R* for UNEQUAL block sizes instead of stopping at the fully symmetric case. In the regret theorem, replace the cylindrical-algebraic-decomposition decidability statement and the vacuous support-containment claim with a genuine value bound (e.g. universal upper/lower bounds on R*(n,S) in terms of dim(S), n, and the leverage profile).

review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The headline promises to 'determine' V*(rho;S), rho*(S), and R*(n,S), but for a general score subspace what is actually proved is that a compact convex-concave game has a saddle point and an attaining mixture (thm:exact-oracle-saddle) and that the value can be written as an exponential-size SDP; the 'characterizations' S in A_n iff kappa(S) < c_n and rho*(S) = sqrt(gamma(S)) are near-restatements of the definitions of v*(1;S) and of the dual slope, with the only real content being a continuity limit as rho goes to 1. The genuinely new and non-obvious content reduces to three items: the floor gamma(S) >= dim(S)/(n-1) (a one-line trace bound) together with its iff-equal-leverage equality case (this direction, via the affine hull of the balanced cut polytope and a minimizing-sequence case split, is the only technically demanding proof in the note), the parity criterion kappa(S_P)=0 iff all blocks are even, and the closed-form oracle value and regret for HOMOGENEOUS even blocks — where Kiefer-style orbit averaging collapses the problem to two scalars (a,b) with pa+hb=n, after which the answer is elementary LP. Supporting machinery is padded rather than new: the rank-one-exact lift is the classical S-procedure for one quadratic constraint, the minimax step is a from-scratch re-proof of a standard finite-dimensional minimax theorem, thm:exact-pair-space-regret is a verbatim specialization of lem:pair-space-exact-frontier (m=2) and adds nothing, and thm:finite-unknown-quality-regret's 'computability' is generic semialgebraic decidability while its final conclusion — that the attaining design's support lies inside the support of the rho=0 oracle — is vacuously true because complete randomization is supported on all of Z_n. The framing is mostly disciplined (the Honest scope section concedes no polynomial-time claim and no universal closed form), but 'delivers the exact oracle value' and 'gives the exact additive regret' oversell a result that for general S is only an exponential program plus an existence-of-minimizer statement, with actual formulas confined to the symmetric geometry where the problem is easy.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Turn the variational invariant into an actual determination: prove a two-sided quantitative bound for gamma(S) as an explicit function of the leverage profile diag(P_S) (e.g. a matching upper bound in terms of max_i (P_S)_ii or the leverage dispersion), so the admissibility threshold is read off the score matrix rather than from an exponential enumeration, and push the already-established block-sum moment-polytope reduction through to closed-form v* and R* for UNEQUAL block sizes instead of stopping at the fully symmetric case. In the regret theorem, replace the cylindrical-algebraic-decomposition decidability statement and the vacuous support-containment claim with a genuine value bound (e.g. universal upper/lower bounds on R*(n,S) in terms of dim(S), n, and the leverage profile).
